meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 Codex 替代或配合 Claude 作为 agent 规划器
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Claude 之外使用 Codex 作为 agent 核心
copy.tagline_en: Use Codex as a full agent provider alongside or instead of Claude
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to use Codex as the agent planner instead of or alongside Claude

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以用 OpenAI 的 Codex 作为智能体后端，负责规划、调用工具、管理对话历史，并支持会话恢复。
howto.when: 当你为某个群组设置 provider 为 codex 并重启后，该群组的对话会由 Codex 处理。

say.text: 帮我用 Codex 规划一个项目，列出需要的工具。
say.note: Codex 会作为智能体进行规划和工具调用。

say.text: 切换到 Codex 提供商，然后继续刚才的对话。
say.note: 需要先通过命令切换 provider 并重启群组。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use OpenAI's Codex as a full agent backend for planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, and session resume.
howto.when_en: When you set the provider to codex for a group and restart it, the group's conversations will be handled by Codex.

say_en.text: Help me plan a project using Codex and list the tools needed.
say_en.note: Codex will act as the agent for planning and tool orchestration.

say_en.text: Switch to Codex provider and resume the previous conversation.
say_en.note: Requires switching provider via command and restarting the group.
